question.name: CSEC Phy Jun 2023 Q5b(ii) — Factors That Increase Electromagnet Strength
question.text:
List TWO factors that would increase the strength of an electromagnet:

Factor 1: [[1]]

Factor 2: [[2]]
question.general_feedback:
Ways to increase electromagnet strength:

  • Increase the current through the coil — more current → stronger magnetic field
  • Increase the number of turns on the coil — more turns → more magnetic field lines per unit length
  • Use a soft iron core inside the coil — iron concentrates and amplifies the magnetic field (high permeability)

Note: Lengthening the coil without adding turns decreases field strength. Using a non-magnetic core (e.g. wood, plastic) instead of soft iron greatly reduces strength.

ddwtos.word_bank_note: 6 tokens for 2 slots. 3 correct — any 2 earn full marks. The 3 false tokens are direct opposites of the correct answers, testing whether students know the direction of each factor's effect. 'Decrease the current' and 'decrease the number of turns' are common wrong-direction errors. 'Non-magnetic core' is included because students sometimes confuse core material type.
